summary_en: On November 9, 2024, the company announced execution of its block buyback on the same day at the closing price of ¥1,451 per share through N-NET3, with a maximum of 60,000 shares (1.20% of outstanding shares) and maximum acquisition amount of ¥90 million.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (N-NET3)
translation_en_brief: On November 9, 2024, Gozaiza announced execution of a block buyback program. The company's board of directors decided to acquire treasury stock through N-NET3, an off-hours trading system at the Nagoya Stock Exchange. The acquisition was executed on November 10, 2024 at the previous day's closing price of ¥1,451 per share, with a maximum of 60,000 shares representing 1.20% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The maximum acquisition amount was set at ¥90 million. The execution was conducted as a limit order valid only during the specified trading time window on the morning of November 10. As of September 30, 2024, the company held 5,294 treasury shares against an outstanding share count of 4,979,206 shares (excluding treasury stock).
